left.raw_text: - Subjects should be capable of walking,
and ramps with full capability in lower extremity passive range of motion (knee flexion contracture of >10 degrees, knee flexion ROM < 90 degrees, hip flexion contracture < 25 degrees,

right.raw_text: and ankle plantar flexion contracture of >15 degrees).

left.raw_text: - Subjects must be able to walk for at least 5 minutes

right.raw_text: and willing and able to participate over a 1-6 hours experiment with breaks and rest enforced regularly and as needed.

left.raw_text: - Subjects must be able to transfer (sit-to-stand
and stand-to-sit) with no external support (arm rests OK) and to ambulate over small slopes (3 degrees)
